title: `topics/testing-consciousness-collapse` misdescribes Kremnizer & Ranchin (2015) as a "Phi-threshold" model ("Systems exceeding a Φ threshold undergo spontaneous localisation; systems below it remain in superposition", L117). In the paper the collapse rate is a continuous function of Φ(ρ), zero only when Φ(ρ) = 0. The error appears at 6 sites: L115 heading, L117, L161, L196 table, L228, L232
